prepared_table.formula: fixed = (annuity(lifetime, discount rate) + FOM/100) x investment [EUR/MW]; marginal_cost = VOM + fuel/efficiency; per-kW units x 1e3

rebase.method: EUR(currency_year) -> EUR2020 with the ECB EA20 GDP deflator, factor = index(2020)/index(currency_year); non-monetary rows unchanged
rebase.note: technology-data inflated 2020->2025 with Eurostat HICP (about +25.7 %); dividing by the EA20 GDP deflator (+20.0 %) leaves about +4.8 % on unchanged source values
